newsitem.title: ITALY: BOXING-WBO CHAMPION PARISI MAKES QUICK WORK OF REY.
newsitem.headline: BOXING-WBO CHAMPION PARISI MAKES QUICK WORK OF REY.

text.p: Italy's former Olympic champion Giovanni Parisi stopped Spaniard Sergio Rey in the fourth round on Saturday to retain his World Boxing Organisation super-lightweight title.
Parisi, a 1988 Olympic featherweight gold medallist whose professional record is now 33-1-2, never looked in danger from the outclassed Spaniard.
He rocked his opponent early in the fourth with a hard left that made Rey's knees buckle.

Rey was lucky to escape a standing count then but he took two more -- caught by a right and then later by a fierce jab to the head -- before his corner hurriedly threw in the towel two minutes and three seconds into the round.
It was the 28-year-old Parisi's second title defence.
